title: Order Change and Cancellation Schedule — Ridgeline Special Order Services
content:
Each program of Ridgeline Special Order Services sets its own window for changing an order, its free cancellation window, its cancellation fee before production and the days the vendor has to confirm.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Change window (hours)** — hours after the order is placed during which it may be changed without cancelling, provided the vendor has not confirmed it.
- **Free cancellation window (hours)** — hours after the order is placed during which it may be cancelled with no fee, provided production has not started and it has not shipped.
- **Cancellation fee before production (percent)** — the cancellation fee, as a percentage of the order total, after the free window and before production or shipment.
- **Minimum cancellation fee (USD)** — the smallest cancellation fee when a percentage fee applies.
- **Cancellable after production starts** — whether the customer may cancel once production has started, outside the vendor-delay remedy.
- **Free cancellation on a vendor change** — whether the customer may cancel free when the vendor changes the price, specification or lead time after the order.
- **Vendor confirmation period (calendar days)** — days after the order within which the vendor must confirm, failing which the order is cancelled free.

## Schedule

| Program | Change window (hours) | Free cancellation window (hours) | Fee before production (percent) | Minimum fee (USD) | Vendor confirmation period (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 24 | 72 | 15 | 25.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 12 | 24 | 25 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 12 | 24 | 100 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 24 | 48 | 25 | 100.00 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 48 | 72 | 25 | 250.00 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 24 | 24 | 50 | 250.00 | 5 |

| Program | Cancellable after production starts | Free cancellation on a vendor change |
|---|---|---|
| every program listed above | no | yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- No program allows a customer cancellation once production has started outside the vendor-delay remedy, and every program allows a free cancellation when the vendor changes the price, specification or lead time after the order.
- Made-to-Measure Window Coverings carries a fee of 100 percent of the order total after its free window, with no separate minimum (0.00).
- Fabricated Countertops has the same 24-hour length for its change window and its free cancellation window.
